0.name: Original
0.desc: The nostalgic, original combat UI. Practical and has weathered countless battles with us.

101.name: New
101.desc: A redesigned and recolored UI, providing you with a more dynamic visual experience.

102.name: Cyber
102.desc: A UI for enthusiasts of science-fiction. Features some animations and light effects in places.

103.name: Iridescent Fantasy
103.desc: An expressive UI featuring all the colors of the rainbow. Perfect for those who like to swing to the rhythm and fans of pop aesthetics.

104.name: Neon
104.desc: Augment your combat experience with neon lights and rhythmic light beams.

105.name: Holy Light
105.desc: Sacred, profound, glorious. May all your battles be etched into the annals of history.

106.name: Deal with the Devil
106.desc: A command interface with a devilish vibe. Its blood-red frame and magic circles beckon you to a dark and dangerous world.

107.name: Radiant Stars
107.desc: Brightly do the stars glow, projecting their mysterious patterns across the galaxy, their each and every detail speaking to a longing for space and adventure.

108.name: Natural Flow
108.desc: Listen to Mother Nature's vivid tune, performed by running water and birdsong.

109.name: Ink and Bamboo
109.desc: An interface in the style of an ink painting. Ink brushstrokes unfold between black and white, whilst the bamboo seems to sway in the wind, creating an elegant atmosphere.

110.name: Black Friday
110.desc: This Battle UI is designed for shopping-loving Commanders. While enjoying the thrill of shopping, overwhelm your opponents with a deluge of gifts.
110.unlock: Obtained from Black Friday Cruise Pass.

111.name: Shadow Pictures
111.desc: Simple shadow pictures evoke boundless imagination, and modest stories abound with wonderful hopes.

113.name: Ancient Dynasty
113.desc: Adorn your interface with towering stone pillars, their worn patterns telling tales of a lost order and filling your battles with a solemn and tragic atmosphere that transcends time.

114.name: Elderwood Ivy
114.desc: A mystical glow filters through the gaps of the ancient ivy growing around your screen. Grace each battle with the enchantment and vitality of the deep forest.

115.name: Azure Core
115.desc: A rusty, mechanical heart beats anew, reverberating with the souls of ancient civilizations.

116.name: Olde Royal
116.desc: Light and shadow from a bygone era flow, the elegant tones of nobility in resonance. Brings a touch of grace and class to your battle.

117.name: Bounties and Bullets
117.desc: Make each battle a melody of gunpowder, magazines, and bullet holes, echoing from a saloon lost to time – an invitation to an elegant yet dangerous romance.

201.name: Christmas
201.desc: An interface for those who adore the atmosphere of winter. Embrace the holiday spirit and watch the snowflakes fall while you take command of the battle.
201.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack - Christmas

202.name: Pharaoh
202.desc: Hieroglyphs and gold emblazonings. They retell the legends of the Nile culture from time immemorial.
202.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack - Pharaoh

203.name: Genetic Origin
203.desc: A futuristic command interface. The white panels and blood-red highlights provide a clinical and suspenseful atmosphere.
203.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack - Genetic Origin

204.name: Battle UI - Seaside Splash
204.desc: Planks placed in the sand and white-crested waves adorned with seashells. A leisurely vacation on the beach.
204.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack - Seaside Splash

205.name: Ninja Castle
205.desc: For the Commander who just can't get enough of ninjas. Take your shuriken and kunai and wreak some havoc in the ninja castle!
205.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack - Ninja Castle

206.name: Maid Café
206.desc: Indulge in sweet snacks made by a loving maid and take on new and sugary challenges!
206.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack – Maid Café

207.name: Springtide Inn
207.desc: Bask in the lively atmosphere at Springtide Inn, see the fireworks and the lanterns, and listen to the pop-pop-pop of firecrackers. Welcome spring with a bang!
207.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack – Springtide Inn

208.name: Gilded Reverie
208.desc: A river of gold coalesces into the shape of stars, each button studded with glistening diamonds. Transform every battle into an opulent, glamorous dream.
208.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack - Gilded Reverie

209.name: YoRHa
209.desc: A minimalist, monochrome UI. Its impersonal, mechanical patterns and tactical interface are arranged in an orderly manner, creating an atmosphere reminiscent of the YoRHa squadron.
209.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack - YoRHa

210.name: Candlelit Ritual
210.desc: In the hall of mirrors where candlelight flickers, the paranormal intertwines like creeping thorns. Let each battle unveil a prologue to a drama wavering between reality and illusion.
210.unlock: Buy the Battle UI Pack - Candlelit Ritual
